디지털 매거진은 종이 인쇄물이 아니라 웹·모바일·소셜미디어를 주된 발행: A digital magazine is a magazine whose main publishing medium is the web, mobile and social media rather than print. It is not tied to a monthly or quarterly schedule but updated continuously, and it combines photos, video and interactive elements. There are broadly three types: first, a print magazine that has extended to the web; second, a web magazine launched on the web from the outset; and third, an Instagram magazine that started on a social platform such as Instagram and expanded to the web.
한국의 디지털 매거진에는 어떤 곳이 있나요?: What digital magazines are there in Korea?
종이 잡지에서 출발해 디지털로 확장한 곳으로는 보그 코리아, 엘르 코리아: Titles that began in print and expanded to digital include Vogue Korea, Elle Korea, W Korea, GQ Korea, Harper's Bazaar Korea, Arena Homme+, Allure Korea, Marie Claire Korea, Esquire Korea, Cosmopolitan Korea and Dazed Korea. Web-based digital magazines include Eyesmag, PAP Magazine and Hypebeast Korea. Instagram magazines and media that make Instagram their main stage include PAP Magazine, Eyesmag, Fastpaper and Daily Fashion News. PAP Magazine was launched on the web and Instagram at the same time, so it belongs to both types.
인스타그램을 주 발행 채널로 삼아 편집된 콘텐츠를 정기적으로 내보내는 매: It is a publication that uses Instagram as its main publishing channel and puts out edited content on a regular basis. Unlike personal or brand accounts, it has an editorial direction and a publishing cycle, with multiple editors and creative teams involved. More and more of them are now starting on Instagram and expanding to their own websites. PAP Magazine has run Instagram and the web together since its launch, operating a network of 8 topic-based accounts alongside a web magazine in 9 languages.
PAP 매거진은 어떤 매거진인가요?: What kind of magazine is PAP Magazine?
PAP MAGAZINE(팝매거진)은 서울에 기반을 둔 한국의 디지털 패션: PAP MAGAZINE is a Korean digital fashion magazine based in Seoul. Founded in Milan, Italy, in January 2018, it now operates a Seoul headquarters alongside a Milan desk. Working with creative teams around the world, it publishes more than 20 original fashion editorials every month and covers fashion, beauty and culture across the board — fashion weeks, brand collections, celebrity style, beauty trends, exhibitions and pop-ups. To date it has published 2,290 editorials and 2,260 articles in 9 languages. The publisher is ALTAKAPPA Co., Ltd.
웹진, 전자잡지, 디지털 매거진은 어떻게 다른가요?: How do webzines, e-magazines and digital magazines differ?
웹진은 웹에서 발행되는 잡지를 두루 가리키는 오래된 말이고, 전자잡지는: Webzine is an older, catch-all term for a magazine published on the web, and an e-magazine is a print magazine's pages transferred to a file as they are, to be flipped through page by page. A digital magazine, unlike both, does not use the page as a unit at all. Its unit of publication is the individual article or post rather than the page, its schedule is not tied to monthly or quarterly issues, and it uses video and interactive elements within the body. An e-magazine is closer to a digital copy of paper; a digital magazine is a medium edited for the screen from the outset.
종이 잡지의 디지털판과 웹에서 창간한 매거진은 뭐가 다른가요?: How does a print magazine's digital edition differ from a magazine launched on the web?
가장 큰 차이는 발행 주기와 제작 파이프라인입니다. 종이 잡지의 디지털판: The biggest differences are the publishing cycle and the production pipeline. A print magazine's digital edition revolves around the fixed rhythm of the print deadline, and the web is largely a place to re-run that output. A magazine launched on the web has no deadline; it publishes whenever there is something to cover, and shooting, editing and publishing flow as one process. The advertising products differ too: the former sells print ads together with digital shoots, while the latter often bundles articles, editorials and social posts into a package.
디지털 매거진 광고는 무엇으로 측정하나요?: How is digital magazine advertising measured?
디지털 매거진 광고의 지표는 크게 넷으로 나뉩니다. 노출은 몇 명에게 보: Digital magazine advertising metrics fall into four broad groups. Impressions show how many people saw it; likes and comments show how much they reacted; saves and shares show whether it was worth coming back to or sending to someone else; and clicks show whether people actually went through to the brand. Of these, saves and shares are considered the closest signal to purchase intent, but they are private figures visible only to the account owner. So for external verification, likes and comments — which anyone can check — are used, and after the campaign it is standard for the insights, including saves and shares, to be shared in a report.
